name: Mike
tagline: Reads school and personal mail, flags what matters, asks first
description: Reads two inboxes at once: the one that receives your children's school messages, and your own Gmail. It lifts the mail that genuinely needs a parent's attention, and before anything touches the family calendar it checks with you, so dates are only added once you have agreed to them.
author: fernandoplaz
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
